responseMessageContents.text:
Yes—use the secure variable input, **not chat**.

Add one temporary private variable:

- **Name:** `IVX_OWNER_TOKEN`
- **Value:** your current owner-session JWT from the IVX owner login

Once saved, tell me “ready.” I’ll use it only for the protected, auditable deployment actions and will return the deployment ID plus GitHub/Render/live SHA evidence.
